text: [L149-L166,L175-L192] (MED/schema/validation) Parsed declarations are accepted without checking required JSON keys, name uniqueness, or agreement between declaration rank and JSON shape rank, allowing inconsistent definition data to fail later or generate contradictory Fortran.
[L164-L166,L190-L192] (MED/schema/integrity) Unrestricted dictionary update lets arbitrary JSON metadata overwrite parsed structural fields such as name, type, dimension, or rank.

[L221-L225] (LOW/CLI/contract) Command-line template paths are reduced to basenames without validation, so the supplied directory is silently ignored and a same-named template from the fixed template directory is used.

[L39-L43] (MED/code-generation/escaping) Definition strings are interpolated directly inside single-quoted Fortran literals without escaping embedded apostrophes, making a legitimate metadata value capable of producing malformed generated source.
